summary: Phase4 requirements define compact provider status, lazy per-provider model loading, fuzzy model search, and bounded chip rendering.

in_scope: Per-provider lazy model loading in the web UI
Advanced settings chip limit and expand/collapse behavior
Automated tests and packaged frontend assets

functional_requirements.statement: /providers must omit full model catalogs by default while retaining provider status and model_count.
acceptance_criteria: GET /providers returns models as an empty list by default
ProviderStatus models is optional-compatible in TypeScript contracts

functional_requirements.statement: The browser must load provider models through /providers/{id}/models only when needed.
acceptance_criteria: Quick connect loads models when a provider is selected
Active model selection loads models when activeProviderId changes
Advanced provider expansion loads that provider's models
Failures show a message and keep manual model ID input available

functional_requirements.statement: Model inputs must use a reusable fuzzy search component instead of datalist.
acceptance_criteria: Quick connect, active model, and advanced default model inputs use ModelSelect
Search matches model id and name by case-insensitive substring with prefix priority
Keyboard ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, and Escape are supported

functional_requirements.statement: Advanced model chips must render a bounded initial list with an explicit more/collapse control.
acceptance_criteria: Only the first 10 models appear initially
A more button shows the remaining count
Expanded chips scroll inside a bounded area and can be collapsed

functional_requirements.statement: The unused all-provider /providers/models endpoint must be removed in favor of the per-provider endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: GET /providers/{id}/models remains the single model catalog endpoint

non_functional_requirements.statement: Initial provider settings load must avoid transferring the full model catalog.
non_functional_requirements.measure: Payload probe shows /providers substantially smaller than /providers?include_models=true

non_functional_requirements.statement: No new third-party frontend dependency is introduced.
non_functional_requirements.measure: ModelSelect is implemented with Vue and TypeScript only

non_functional_requirements.statement: Secrets must not be exposed by changed provider status or tests.
non_functional_requirements.measure: Existing upsert test still asserts no apiKey or fake key in response

user_flows: User opens LLM settings, provider statuses load quickly, then selects a provider and searches for a model.
User expands OpenRouter advanced settings and sees 10 chips plus a more button instead of hundreds of buttons.
User types a model ID manually when model catalog loading fails.
assumptions: Use F-1 A from Phase4.md: remove /providers/models
Use F-2 A from Phase4.md: in-memory cache only

risks.risk: A downstream client could still call /providers/models.
risks.mitigation: Keep /providers?include_models=true and /providers/{id}/models as supported paths; add a server test for 404.

risks.risk: Lazy load failure could block model entry.
risks.mitigation: ModelSelect keeps text input enabled and displays a failure hint.

quality_gates.evidence: Registry and server behavior tests pass.

quality_gates.gate: npm run typecheck and npm run build in frontend
quality_gates.evidence: Vue TypeScript and packaged frontend assets are valid.
Python control-plane regressions and lint pass.
